recipes.name: Best Butternut Squash Soup Ever
ingredients_raw: 0.5 butternut squash - peeled, seeded, and cut into 1-inch cubes
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and thyme and sauté until onion has softened, about 5 minutes. Add squash and chicken broth; bring to a simmer, then cook until squash is tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Crumble bouillon into the soup. Season with cumin, allspice, salt, and pepper, then remove from heat.

Working in batches, pour soup into a blender, filling no more than halfway. Hold the lid in place with a kitchen towel, then carefully start the blender using a few quick pulses to get the soup moving before leaving it on to purée. Pour soup into a serving bowl. Alternately, you can use a stick blender and purée the soup in the pot.

raw_recipe.headline: Best Butternut Squash Soup Ever
raw_recipe.description: This deliciously smooth butternut squash soup is perfectly seasoned with garlic, thyme, cumin, and allspice for a comforting fall soup.

review.reviewBody: Soo delicious! I used the whole butternut squash and roasted it on a baking sheet on broil for 5 min or so to bring out the flavor after cubing it. I also have lemon thyme plants in my yard so I used that instead of regular thyme otherwise I followed the recipe in order with the same sesonings. Perfect for the first snow in the mountains. Thank you.

This really is the best ever! I used a whole squash. Split and roast in the oven at 400 degrees for 40 minutes. Then I followed the rest of the recipe adding all the ingredients to the pot to cook and meld together. The cumin and allspice add that little something that gives this such a rich taste. Depending on the size of the whole squash, when the soup is done, taste and if needed, thin with a little chicken stock. My husband likes to add a dollop of sour cream. My kids are requesting this soup on the reg.

I cooked the onion & thyme in half bacon fat & butter then added the garlic for the last 1-2 minutes. Cubed the squash & tossed with salt, pepper & olive oil the baked 30 minutes @ 400. Combine in stock pot with chicken broth & puree. Add cumin, allspice (or try 1 tsp ginger & 1/2 tsp cinnamon), bouillon & additional chicken broth if needed & puree again. When serving, sprinkle with crushed red pepper & bits of bacon. Can also add coconut milk or heavy cream to make creamier.
I used an acorn squash and roasted it for 45 minutes with the onion and garlic. I added the squash to the broth with the onion and garlic and cooked in a pot for about 20 additional minutes.

This is my favorite butternut squash soup recipe. The flavors withe the suggested seasonings are perfect. I use already cubed butternut squash if I can find it, usually at Costco. And use about 4 cups of cubed butternut squash. Also just a little splash of half and half at the end when I purée it. Use an immersion stick blender, it works perfectly. Also the guys in my family like a few bacon crumbles on top of their bowl, adds a little smoky flavor to it.
Like many others, I roasted the butternut squash in the oven first (with olive oil and salt and pepper) and then added the juice of one orange and orange zest (saw this in another recipe). Delicious!
Great recipe & have made this multiple times! It is extremely easy if using an immersion blender. I added a cup of cream & crumbled bacon on the top.

This recipe is really good I followed the recipe except that I too roasted the Butternut Squash and onions and the garlic so this made it a yummy recipe. When I do serve this I will serve it with some pumpkin seeds on top and a squirt bottle of Sour Cream I also use the Crema and that’s a little bit easier on the palette then I think the regular Sour Cream has. I almost forgot to add is I grate Allspice with the Crema, Pumpkin Seeds it add flavor. Well enjoy and happy fall.🍁🍁

Love this soup. Instead of boiling, I roast the squash basted with butter and seasoned with salt pepper and herbs, along with the onion and also add a bell pepper. This adds a smokey essence to the soup. Purée the balance of ingredients with roasted veggies and broth. So yummy!!

Only change is that I use a full squash. I roast it ahead of time in large pieces and it makes it easy to scoop out of the skin I will also use dried thyme if I don't have fresh herbs Use my immersion blender to make it smoothe This is a delicious soup. Anyone I've made it for loves it. Also it has all healthy ingredients save for a small amount of butter.

Restaurant quality! I was doubling the recipe so I was sort of winging it slightly. Used about 4 cups of cubed squash, a whole onion, 6 cups of stock, added a little cinnamon and probably a half tablespoon or so of brown sugar. Then as I was pureeing each batch in my food processor, I added just a little more salt and a couple swirls of half and half. Perfect! I'll be making this recipe for years to come I'm sure.
Great! Thanks for sharing.
I have never cooked or used squash in my life but this recipe was amazing and they loved it. I substituted the fresh thyme for dried ones. Definitely saving it in my books! Thank you!

This recipe ask for 1/2 butternut squash. What amount by pounds or cup of cubes would this recipe call for? I buy the squash by the pound and some are gigantic and some small. I would get different amounts of squash by the pound. I don't want to make with not enough squash for the recipe. I will try the recipe and use a 2lb squash so half will be one pound. hope it taste good.
Great!
This is one of the better squash soups I've had, but at some point I'll just have to concede that they aren't really my preference. This soup was good, though.
I added a diced green apple to give it a sweetness.
